note: Read 2026-11-04 by the research of a series and a play in every market (scratchpad l4t: the first wave t1-t8 and the follow-up u1-u25, merged item by item, the later verdict standing where it read more): what a series' and a play's producer can draw on there. Each quote kept was found in its saved file (the integrator's check, 2026-11-04); a quote not found there was left out, and a figure with none left was left out with it. Attempts recorded for a web search the shared allowance refused were dropped, not being attempts.

sources.title: OIF: Appel à projets « Écritures et (co)productions » 2026
sources.said: Être une entité2 légalement enregistrée dans l’un des 90 États et gouvernements membres de l’OIF ; … Le montant indicatif global mis à disposition au titre du présent appel à projets s’élève à 130 000 euros. … Les subventions accordées devront être comprises entre 7 000 et 20 000 euros par projet. … La subvention demandée à l’OIF ne devra pas dépasser 70 % du coût total du projet. … • Date limite de soumission : 2 avril 2026 … Centrafrique

figures.finding: The only theatre money found that a Central African entity can apply for (CAR is listed as an OIF member); closed for 2026. No national fund found.

value.fund: OIF 'Écritures et (co)productions' 2026 (regional, francophone), live-performance strand among others
value.applicant: legally registered entity in an OIF state or government, three years in the cultural sector
